dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: You know, it occurs to me that I'd probably get along with the manager of this mysterious place really well.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: When I first got here, I heard that elegant and dignified symphony. It's my favorite kind of music.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: If we ever got to meet, I'd present them with the perfect dish to accompany that symphony, as a thank-you gift for the great mood this music's put me in.
